name: Fetiche no Casal
description: This is a free interactive talk about fetishism in relationships, led by Maisie B. The event explores how fetishes can impact couples, focusing on desire, intimacy, and communication.
longDescription:
The event "Fetiche no Casal" is a free interactive talk led by Maisie B. from SubSexcretary. It takes place on November 14, 2026, from 6 PM to 7 PM, at The Knoty (W)Hole in Porto.

The discussion focuses on the role of fetishism within relationships, exploring how it can either strengthen or challenge a couple's bond. Maisie B. will use anonymized real-life cases and data on sexuality to facilitate a conversation about desire, fantasy, and communication between partners. The event is open to curious individuals, beginners, and those already familiar with fetishism.

This talk is not a training session but a sharing event, designed to create a judgment-free space for participants. Prior registration is required, and the venue will be exclusively for attendees to ensure comfort and confidentiality.

Esta conversa não é uma sessão de formação, mas sim um evento de partilha, pensado para criar um espaço sem julgamentos para os participantes. É necessário fazer inscrição prévia, e o local será exclusivo para os inscritos, para garantir conforto e confidencialidade.
